newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil BNDES sees no delay in CVRD sale.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BNDES sees no delay in CVRD sale.

text.p: The president of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) said an eventual congressional inquiry into the privatization of state mining concern Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) would not delay the firm's sell-off.
"The installation of a Parliamentary Committee of Inquiry would not alter Vale's sell-off schedule," Luiz Carlos Mendonca de Barros told reporters.
Congressmen opposing to the company's privatization have been mulling an inquiry into the sell-off process.
Mendonca de Barros also said he sees two consortia -- one led by cement group Grupo Votorantim and another led by private steelmaker CSN -- being formed to bid at Vale's auction on April 29.
CSN, however, has found it difficult to build its group after private bank Bradesco and Gencor dropped out of the race.
He also said if there was only one consortium bidding at the auction, it would prove that Vale's minimum price was high and only one group of investors was able to participate in the auction.
